scope: New independently integrated mechanistic tests in the same selected HH model. Diagnostic reductions are explicitly separated from the complete network.

demonstrated_in_model.condition: Retain these four cells only; original160pA tonic DN input, I1 excitatory gain2 inherited from prior selected model
demonstrated_in_model.observation: 4s run: DN continuous about77.82Hz; sequential E1/E2/I1 about13.4/13.4/13.5Hz. At1–3.9s E1 intervals64.44–89.06ms; not claimed perfectly periodic.
demonstrated_in_model.limit: MN clamped in this reduced condition, so this does not establish muscle or whole-body reproduction.

demonstrated_in_model.condition: Same reduced motif, silenceI1 or cut its return edges
demonstrated_in_model.observation: Slow13Hz core mode replaced by E1/E2 about39Hz. With E2 silence, I1 stops and E1 is about39Hz.
demonstrated_in_model.limit: I1 output sign follows inherited glutamate receptor assumption.

demonstrated_in_model.condition: Full network; cut specified type-pair edges
demonstrated_in_model.observation: Left/right I1 spikes:baseline15/14; E2→I1 cut0/7; IN19B012→I1 cut8/0; joint cut0/0. Source-resolved conductance reconstruction matches recorded conductances.
demonstrated_in_model.limit: These are all matching type-pair cuts in the selected network, not single-edge or laboratory manipulations.

demonstrated_in_model.observation: First MN responses are driven by direct DN excitation and precede E2. Removing167 direct DN→MN edges delays these responses; exact timing is logged at0.0125ms integration steps.

demonstrated_in_model.condition: E2 silenced and direct DN→MN cut
demonstrated_in_model.observation: Relay-to-MN targeted cuts further delay left response212.51→217.38ms and right response221.29→236.14ms. Additional inputs still rescue later activity.
demonstrated_in_model.limit: Parallel pathways identified rather than declaring residual output an unexplained failure.

not_satisfied_or_not_established.reason: Full network retains repeated concrete MN output after E2 silence. Reduced core success does not transfer this necessity to the full brain/VNC network.

Single and combined silencing were run. Full-network and DN+VNC conditions still have alternative neuronal/MN output after combined silencing; persisted upstream DN activity confounds simple firing-count conclusions.
Manual efficacy/gain variants change recruitment but no demonstrated stable alternating six-leg pattern. Reduced four-cell conditions have no active MN.
Turning, braking, sensory load, grooming, hunger and individual fast/slow MN phenotypes require their specific protocols; these routing tests do not validate them.

working_model_update: Previous selected candidate retained; interventions and unsuccessful parameter trials are durably saved without overwriting the original model.
